summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, a social hub, lore destinations and a solo tutorial. `templates/player.js` composes shared player behaviors, while place sims lay and tick local worlds; Level 0 now also opens onto a generated Christmas Area pocket with its own Still Life encounters and loot.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes and generated landmarks including Level 0.2, Zenith entry and the north-rim Christmas Area.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops/escalators and simulated staff; Rico's platform routine and Bonus Line boarding cooperate.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Level 0.2 sim/grid own its shifting basement.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level26, level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender, lake and deeper destinations; local sims own specialized environments and routes.

places/level11, places/level12, places/level13 (3D) - Infinite City and Matrix-to-Boiling-Frogs destinations; Level 13 has Floor 283 reception, numbered halls, furnished/story-bearing flats, residents, foes and B8 tape.
places/testlab + places/spamton (3D) - authored test and bonus spaces.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout and the generated, data-driven Christmas Area pocket.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js; places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js - seeded maze moments and Level 1 layout/camp/doors.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.
places/level13/sim.js + scripts/lib/level13.js + level13-furnish.js/level13-dress.js/level13-foes.js/level13-people.js/level13-tape.js - Floor 283 shell and cooperating furnished/story layers.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations and door/model proximity-preload manifest.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js and scripts/lib/sign-style.js + scripts/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/id generated sign boards.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue.js/dlg-*.yml/npc-starters.js supply conversations.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/level13.js + scripts/lib/data/level13.yml - Level 13 floor-plan dimensions and measured shell/furnishing/story layout shared by its layers.

scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml + clothes.yml - Tripo cat body, modeled/painted garments, hair/ears/eyewear and mappings from game apparel; salon and cat rendering reuse it.
notableExports: scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - layXmas; scripts/lib/maze.js - XMAS_CELL and maze cell/zone helpers.
scripts/xmas-geo.js - geometry(ctx); scripts/xmas-still.js - update(ctx, dt) for Lamp Sitter and Red Stray behaviors.
scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js - CAT_BODY, CAT_OLD, CAT_BODY2, paintOf, skinParams, catModel, catMorph, catChildren, printOf, liveFace and appearance option constants.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe, MEAT, CASH and money; shared item tokens are consumed by interaction, loot UI and player inventory.
scripts/door-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack.
scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - wallLine, yawOf, layGrid, layPaint, resetGrid, joists, gridTick; scripts/lib/l02-wall-geo.js - geometry, collider.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, weaponAim, onInput, hitTarget, HOLO/holoEnd and throwable callbacks.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position and carried tapes; this now includes bauble/snack/weapon inventory and Christmas Area immunity to Level 0 hum within configured bounds.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest handlers own quest-specific state; dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary, dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, l02paint, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.

scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js own kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js own loose prop/wreck and breakable state, including place.state.gone and wall breakage/timestamps.
scripts/lib/knock.js + stats.js - foe weight/attributes and down/stagger outcomes; enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget.
places/level02/sim.js owns phase/caseLandAt and reset markers; scripts/lib/l02-grid.js writes place.state.l02grid.layout, while scripts/lib/l02-use.js writes its lamps map.
scripts/lib/xmas-room.js owns place.state.xmasV and the xmas-prefixed generated landmark; scripts/xmas-still.js keeps sitter/stray behavior session and combat fields on those objects.
Level 13 sim/layers own separate placement/version markers; retain player.state.leth13 and its per-player dwell timing, place.state.v, tape container contents and foe memory/dead-slot timestamps.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; Bonus Line boarding is separate.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time; hub UI routes Bonus/home destinations.

places/main/sim.js cadence (1s, while players are present) → layXmas(ctx) → scripts/lib/data/xmas.yml + scripts/xmas-geo.js populate the north-rim opening, dark Entrance Room, connecting hall, red Ornate Room and closed far door/closet.
maze.js XMAS_CELL opens that north-rim wall → xmas doorway and pocket beyond; player.js reads xmas.yml bounds to suppress Level 0 hum inside the pocket.

xmas-room.js attaches scripts/xmas-still.js to Lamp Sitter and Red Stray → sitter wakes/aims its lamp near players; Red Stray pursues, knocks/forces the far door and backs off from light, reading xmas.yml values.

Christmas Area containers (present, Still Lifes, thermos, house, candy cane) store standard item tokens → interact/loot → items.js/player.js; bauble and exclusive items are described/rendered through shared inventory UI.
player.js throws selected frag/molotov/bauble → scripts/nade.js reads throwables.yml, simulates contact/fuse and emits effects; bauble shatters, damages/dazes nearby targets.
scripts/interact.js loot search → loot.gateItems → items/weapons roll; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; focus → player.state.focus → loot/talk/shop UI.
scripts/talk.js opens dialogue.js → dlg-*.yml; npc-starters.js adds contextual/quest choices, talk validates checks and dispatches quest handlers, then voices.js/hear.js gate speech per listener.

places/level13/sim.js calls layFurnish/layPeople/layTape and maintains lethargy; each subsystem uses its own placement data/version, with measured furnishing dimensions and resident/story data shared from its catalogs.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus scenes + bonus data/sim + mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall and counter behavior; sim lays staff and Rico, whose platform schedule and Bonus Line boarding are separate cooperating routines.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration; styles include flat veneer and plain yellow.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + l02-remodel.yml + l02-wall-geo.js - data-varied basement partitions rebuilt when out of view, lamp-lit locks, crew dressing, knocks, and reset.
Level 13: level13-furnish.js + level13.yml vary flat furnishing/story; level13-dress.js + l13-dress.yml lay hall traces/doors; foe, people and tape layers define encounters/residents/salvage.

Level 0 Christmas Area: xmas-room.js + xmas.yml lays a versioned, data-sized set; xmas-geo.js builds parameterized props and xmas-still.js supplies two shared behavior roles (lamp sitter and hostile stray).
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV; sign-style only restyles eligible shallow UI boxes.

Door transfers: carryAcross records xferTo only for local place links with a # marker and crosses carryId/nearby heldBy objects, rejecting room/world and Bonus destinations; Level 1 BACK uses backV destroy-and-respawn migration.

Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuild destroys old l3-hatch-* objects; hatchAt deterministically shares each wall's door across its two faces. Level 3 lineV=2 replaces legacy line-model instances with three Tripo stations and animated belt boxes.

Level 0.2 sim V=25 rebuilds generated roots; preserve phase/caseLandAt and debris tags, plus the 15-second empty reset. Grid state remains place.state.l02grid={layout, lamps}; walls swap on six-second passes with view/near/lamp exclusions.
Christmas Area data v=2 controls layXmas: a version change destroys xmas-prefixed objects and rebuilds them; keep scripts/lib/maze.js XMAS_CELL, xmas.yml cell/bounds, and the main sim entry aligned.
